scientific_integrity: The orthic cosine-product relation is classical. New analysis concerns its random area-ratio distribution; stochastic checks do not certify infinite asymptotics. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Three independent angular-uniform circle points only; extended altitude feet for obtuse triangles; leading endpoints, exact mean, no full density; historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp logarithmic and linear tails of the orthic-area ratio of a random cyclic triangle
